scenarios.title: Offline Stock Submission
scenarios.description: Staff submits O+ Whole Blood update while offline. Update is queued in IndexedDB. On reconnect, auto-syncs to backend.
steps: Select bank: Apollo Hospital Blood Bank, Mumbai

scenarios.title: SMS Stock Update via Webhook
scenarios.description: Simulates a staff member sending an SMS that is parsed and stored via the webhook endpoint.
steps: Backend parses: blood_group=O+, component=Whole Blood, units=15
Response: TwiML XML with confirmation message

scenarios.title: Search with No Results
scenarios.description: User searches for AB- Cryoprecipitate near a location with no stock — graceful empty state shown.
steps: Set location to remote coordinates (e.g., lat=20.0, lon=80.0)
Result: empty state with message and 'Expand search radius' prompt

scenarios.title: Stale Bank Detection on Dashboard
scenarios.description: Dashboard highlights banks that have not reported in 24+ hours.
steps: Observe 'Silent Banks' metric card showing count
Observe map markers in dash-stale (#DA3633) red for stale banks
Observe table listing stale banks with last-reported timestamp
